usageNotes: Retrieves a single entry from an SDN prefix list by its sequence number. Use this to inspect a specific IP prefix/network rule within a named prefix list before modifying or deleting it. Requires SDN.Audit privilege on the prefix list object; SDN must be configured and the prefix list must exist.

examples.summary: Fetch entry at sequence 10 from prefix list 'rfc1918'

tips: The url_seq value corresponds to the sequence number assigned when the prefix list entry was created — list all entries first if the sequence number is unknown.
SDN prefix lists are cluster-wide; this endpoint reads from the SDN controller configuration, not per-node state.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), making this safe for read-only automation without interactive credentials.
